description: The historical May 2015 codebook at mass_mobilization_extension/baseline/mm_codebook.txt is present and was read read-only; the additional Coding Procedure referenced by it remains unavailable. The DataCite DOI registration record retrieved 2026-10-08 reports registered version 5.1, declared coverage 1990-01-01–2020-03-31, CC0-1.0 and dataset_updated_date 2022-10-10. Those are registration-metadata observations, not verification of current downloadable data bytes, latest file version, filenames/checksums, current schema or country universe. The official reuse gate and compatibility mapping remain unresolved, so the experimental baseline gate remains pending.
required_followup: Coordinator to verify official current data bytes and latest version, filename/checksum inventory, schema, country universe, cutoff and reuse terms before any integration or approval.

description: The Jan 28 union press breakfast is a possible collective-action lead, but neither the opened Banouto article nor the La Nouvelle Tribune search excerpt provides a participant estimate or establishes a public meeting open to the public.
required_followup: Find a contemporary account or source document establishing event format, access and attendance; otherwise retain pending_threshold.

description: No available source gives an event-specific state response or the press event end time; silence is retained as unknown.
required_followup: Seek follow-up reporting or organizer/official documentation that directly addresses response and closure.

description: Le Chasseur Infos S002 returned HTTP 403 and was not retried. La Nation S003 returned a web-tool Cache miss followed by DNS failure on one ordinary exact-URL request. S005 and S007 each returned Cache miss followed by DNS failure on one ordinary exact-URL request. No alternate hosts or routes were tried.
required_followup: If access circumstances change, coordinator may use only the same saved exact URLs after a fresh access review; do not bypass any observed denial.

description: S005 may report the same Jan 28 press event as S001, but its body was unavailable and written-origin/syndication relationship is not established.
required_followup: Compare body/byline/origin records if S005 becomes publicly retrievable; do not count the two items as independent confirmation until resolved.

description: The web search covered four weekly windows, national/local outlets, principal cities and several sectors, but accessible coverage is not equivalent to LexisNexis. French and English material dominated; Fon, Yoruba, Bariba, Dendi and Fulfulde discovery attempts did not yield relevant local-language evidence. National/local and rural coverage may be uneven.
required_followup: Coordinator to consider local-language and regional archive searches, especially outside Cotonou and major outlets; do not infer that unreported actions did not occur.

description: A later union meeting on cost of living is reported for 2022-02-18, and another CSTB meeting for 2022-02-25. They start after January and are treated as separate later acts, not January continuations.
required_followup: Coordinator to review February-unit ownership and whether any separately organized January action preceded those later meetings; do not carry the February acts backward.

description: A Jan 26 Parakou COTEB former-worker article is only a search-result lead. It links payments/political intervention but does not establish a strike, public meeting or collective protest; the exact page returned Cache miss and the single exact-URL HTTPS request failed DNS.
required_followup: Seek another contemporaneous source or accessible original record to determine whether COTEB workers held a public collective action; do not create an event from the headline alone.

description: The Kogandji/Savalou account of casualties comes from a police director statement in S004; Amnesty S008 offers an unread search-result summary of the confrontation but not casualty corroboration.
required_followup: Seek independently opened corroboration only if a later review needs casualty attribution; current exclusion does not depend on the reported death count.
